grist.target_rule: Pressing Shift+F10 in the grid opens the context menu.
grist.pass_observation: The context menu appears after the user presses Shift+F10 in the grid.
grist.fail_observation: No context menu appears after the user presses Shift+F10 in the grid.
grist.probe_question: What appears when you press Shift+F10 in the grid?

grist.target_rule: After a user selects 'Set default: Collapse' for a parent page, its nested pages must be collapsed when the document is reopened.
grist.pass_observation: When the document is reopened, the parent page's nested pages are hidden in the page list.
grist.fail_observation: When the document is reopened, the parent page's nested pages are expanded in the page list.
grist.probe_question: How does selecting 'Set default: Collapse' affect the page list when the document is reopened?

grist.target_rule: Clicking Restart at the bottom of the tutorial popup refreshes the page and discards unsaved changes.
grist.pass_observation: After clicking Restart with an unsaved edit, the page reloads and the edit is absent.
grist.fail_observation: After clicking Restart with an unsaved edit, the edit remains.
grist.probe_question: What happens when you click Restart in the tutorial popup while you have unsaved edits?

grist.target_rule: When suggestions are enabled, opening a document automatically opens a copy for both signed-in and signed-out users.
grist.pass_observation: A user opening the document with suggestions enabled sees a copy, whether signed in or signed out.
grist.fail_observation: A user opening the document with suggestions enabled sees the original instead of a copy.
grist.probe_question: What does a user see when opening a document with suggestions enabled, and does sign-in status affect the result?

grist.target_rule: After a user closes their document fork, visiting the document's Direct URL automatically redirects them to their saved fork.
grist.pass_observation: The user visits the Direct URL after closing their fork and sees their saved fork open automatically.
grist.fail_observation: The user visits the Direct URL after closing their fork and is not automatically taken to their saved fork.
grist.probe_question: What happens when a user visits the Direct URL after closing their document fork?

grist.target_rule: A team may have at most 10 billing managers.
grist.pass_observation: With 10 billing managers already assigned, the web interface prevents assigning an eleventh.
grist.fail_observation: The web interface allows an eleventh billing manager to be assigned.
grist.probe_question: What happens when a user tries to assign another billing manager to a team that already has 10?

immich.target_rule: The web upload interface accepts MP2T video files with the .m2t extension.
immich.pass_observation: A valid .m2t MP2T video is accepted for upload.
immich.fail_observation: A valid .m2t MP2T video is rejected as an unsupported format.
immich.probe_question: What happens when a user uploads an MP2T video with the .m2t extension?

immich.target_rule: In Full path or folder search mode, a query matching part of an asset's original path must include that asset in the results.
immich.pass_observation: Searching for Printing in Full path or folder mode shows the asset whose original path is /John/Projects/3D_Printing/2026-07-01/IMG_0001.jpg.
immich.fail_observation: Searching for Printing in Full path or folder mode omits that asset from the results.
immich.probe_question: Which results appear when you search for Printing in Full path or folder mode?

immich.target_rule: When creating an external library, the web interface must allow assigning it to exactly one user.
immich.pass_observation: The library creation screen permits selecting one owner and does not permit assigning multiple owners.
immich.fail_observation: The library creation screen permits creating a library with multiple owners.
immich.probe_question: How does owner selection work when creating an external library?

mattermost.target_rule: Playbook task text containing Markdown is displayed with Markdown formatting.
mattermost.pass_observation: A task containing **Review** displays Review in bold.
mattermost.fail_observation: A task containing **Review** displays the literal asterisks instead of bold formatting.
mattermost.probe_question: How does a playbook task display text containing Markdown syntax?

mattermost.target_rule: When inviting a guest, the user must select at least one channel before the invitation can be submitted.
mattermost.pass_observation: With no channels selected, the guest invitation cannot be submitted.
mattermost.fail_observation: With no channels selected, the guest invitation is successfully submitted.
mattermost.probe_question: What happens when a user tries to invite a guest without selecting any channels?

mattermost.target_rule: The timezone preference defaults to Automatic.
mattermost.pass_observation: A user with unchanged timezone preferences sees Automatic selected.
mattermost.fail_observation: A user with unchanged timezone preferences sees an option other than Automatic selected.
mattermost.probe_question: Which timezone option is selected before the user changes their preferences?

mattermost.target_rule: Channel messages are automatically translated into the user's preferred language.
mattermost.pass_observation: A channel message written in another language appears translated into the user's preferred language without a manual translation action.
mattermost.fail_observation: A channel message written in another language remains untranslated in the channel.
mattermost.probe_question: How does a channel message appear when its original language differs from your preferred language?

mattermost.target_rule: When a user mentions someone who is not a member of the channel, the web interface prompts them to add that person to the channel.
mattermost.pass_observation: After mentioning a nonmember, the user sees a prompt to add that person to the channel.
mattermost.fail_observation: After mentioning a nonmember, the user sees no prompt to add that person to the channel.
mattermost.probe_question: What happens in the interface when someone mentions a person who is not a member of the channel?

mattermost.target_rule: When anonymous team and channel URLs are enabled, the web team creation flow assigns the team URL automatically without prompting the user to choose it.
mattermost.pass_observation: The user creates a team without seeing a team URL prompt, and the created team has an assigned URL.
mattermost.fail_observation: The team creation flow prompts the user to choose a team URL despite anonymous team and channel URLs being enabled.
mattermost.probe_question: How does team creation handle the team URL when anonymous team and channel URLs are enabled?

mealie.target_rule: A recipe-pool rule using a Food Label includes only recipes with an ingredient bearing that label.
mealie.pass_observation: With a fish Food Label rule applied, the recipe pool includes recipes with fish-labeled ingredients and excludes recipes without them.
mealie.fail_observation: With a fish Food Label rule applied, the recipe pool includes a recipe with no fish-labeled ingredient.
mealie.probe_question: How does applying a Food Label rule affect which recipes appear in the pool?

mealie.target_rule: A user must have Organize group data permission to create a new food through the web interface.
mealie.pass_observation: A user without Organize group data permission cannot create a new food.
mealie.fail_observation: A user without Organize group data permission successfully creates a new food.
mealie.probe_question: What happens when a user without Organize group data permission attempts to add a new food?

nextcloud.target_rule: A device password is accessible in the web interface only when it is created.
nextcloud.pass_observation: The newly created device password is displayed during creation but cannot be revealed after leaving that view.
nextcloud.fail_observation: The user can reveal an existing device password after leaving its creation view.
nextcloud.probe_question: When can a user view a device password in the web interface?

nextcloud.target_rule: Using breakout rooms in a web call divides the call into smaller groups.
nextcloud.pass_observation: The call shows participants assigned to separate breakout rooms.
nextcloud.fail_observation: All participants remain in the original call after breakout rooms are created.
nextcloud.probe_question: What happens to participants when breakout rooms are created during a call?

nextcloud.target_rule: Deleting a folder under normal conditions moves it to the trash bin instead of permanently deleting it.
nextcloud.pass_observation: The deleted folder appears in the trash bin.
nextcloud.fail_observation: The deleted folder does not appear in the trash bin.
nextcloud.probe_question: What happens to a folder after you delete it?

nextcloud.target_rule: When Sort favorites up is enabled in Mail appearance settings, favorite messages appear in a separate section above the rest of the message list.
nextcloud.pass_observation: Favorite messages appear in a separate section at the top, above non-favorite messages.
nextcloud.fail_observation: Favorite messages remain mixed with non-favorite messages instead of appearing in a separate top section.
nextcloud.probe_question: How does enabling Sort favorites up affect the message list?

nextcloud.target_rule: Confirming Delegate access makes the shared mail account appear in the selected delegate's account list marked as delegated.
nextcloud.pass_observation: The selected delegate sees the shared account in their account list with a delegated marker.
nextcloud.fail_observation: The shared account is missing from the delegate's account list or appears without a delegated marker.
nextcloud.probe_question: What appears in the selected user's account list after account delegation is confirmed?

nextcloud.target_rule: Creating a Calendar event with a Talk conversation as its location creates a conversation visible in the conversation list if none exists yet.
nextcloud.pass_observation: The newly created conversation appears in the conversation list.
nextcloud.fail_observation: No conversation appears in the conversation list after the event is created.
nextcloud.probe_question: What appears in the conversation list after creating a Calendar event with a Talk location when no conversation exists yet?

openproject.target_rule: When automatic theme mode is selected, OpenProject must match the operating system’s contrast setting.
openproject.pass_observation: With automatic theme mode selected, enabling the operating system’s high-contrast setting makes the web interface display increased contrast.
openproject.fail_observation: With automatic theme mode selected, enabling the operating system’s high-contrast setting leaves the web interface at normal contrast.
openproject.probe_question: How does the web interface respond to changes in the operating system’s contrast setting while automatic theme mode is selected?

openproject.target_rule: Changing the work package table configuration automatically updates the results displayed in the table.
openproject.pass_observation: The table displays results matching the changed configuration without a manual refresh.
openproject.fail_observation: The table retains the previous results until the user manually refreshes it.
openproject.probe_question: What happens to the displayed results when the work package table configuration changes?

openproject.target_rule: When inviting a new member, the web interface must allow selecting an existing user role, group, or placeholder user's permissions as the basis for the new user's permissions.
openproject.pass_observation: The invitation screen offers all three permission bases: existing user role, group, and placeholder user permissions.
openproject.fail_observation: The invitation screen omits at least one of the three permission bases.
openproject.probe_question: What options are available for determining a new member's permissions during invitation?

openproject.target_rule: An archived project must not appear as a selectable option in the project selector.
openproject.pass_observation: The archived project is absent from the project selector's selectable options.
openproject.fail_observation: The archived project remains selectable in the project selector.
openproject.probe_question: How does archiving a project affect what appears in the project selector?

openproject.target_rule: The project's More (three dots) dropdown menu must include an "Add a subproject" option.
openproject.pass_observation: The opened More dropdown displays "Add a subproject".
openproject.fail_observation: The opened More dropdown does not display "Add a subproject".
openproject.probe_question: What options appear when you open the project's More menu?

openproject.target_rule: The project’s attachment visibility setting determines whether the attachments option appears in the Files tab of its work package detailed views.
openproject.pass_observation: With attachment visibility disabled for the project, a work package’s Files tab does not show the attachments option.
openproject.fail_observation: With attachment visibility disabled for the project, a work package’s Files tab still shows the attachments option.
openproject.probe_question: How does changing the project’s attachment visibility setting affect a work package’s Files tab?

paperless.target_rule: A user without User management permissions can edit their own profile through My Profile.
paperless.pass_observation: The user can save a change to their own profile through My Profile despite lacking User management permissions.
paperless.fail_observation: The user is prevented from editing their own profile through My Profile because they lack User management permissions.
paperless.probe_question: What happens when a user without User management permissions tries to edit their own profile through My Profile?

paperless.target_rule: Adding a custom field to a document without specifying a value must preserve any existing value of that field on the document.
paperless.pass_observation: The document still displays the custom field's original value after the field is added without a value.
paperless.fail_observation: The document's existing custom field value is cleared or changed after the field is added without a value.
paperless.probe_question: What happens to an existing custom field value when that field is added to the document without specifying a value?

paperless.target_rule: A user may grant superuser status to another user only if the acting user is a superuser.
paperless.pass_observation: A non-superuser cannot grant superuser status through the web interface.
paperless.fail_observation: A non-superuser successfully grants superuser status to another user through the web interface.
paperless.probe_question: What happens when a non-superuser tries to grant superuser status to another user?

paperless.target_rule: Documents whose processed text is empty or contains only whitespace are skipped.
paperless.pass_observation: A document with whitespace-only processed text is skipped in the web interface.
paperless.fail_observation: A document with whitespace-only processed text is processed in the web interface.
paperless.probe_question: What happens when a document's processed text contains only whitespace?

paperless.target_rule: The {{doc_title}} placeholder cannot be used in title assignment.
paperless.pass_observation: The web interface prevents using {{doc_title}} in a title assignment.
paperless.fail_observation: The web interface accepts {{doc_title}} and uses it in a title assignment.
paperless.probe_question: What happens when a user attempts to use {{doc_title}} in a title assignment?

wekan.target_rule: Toggling “Show week of year (ISO 8601)” in the board Date popup immediately updates the week-number display without requiring Save.
wekan.pass_observation: Week numbers appear or disappear immediately when the toggle changes, before Save is clicked.
wekan.fail_observation: Week-number visibility remains unchanged until Save is clicked.
wekan.probe_question: What happens to week-number visibility when you change “Show week of year (ISO 8601)” before clicking Save?

wekan.target_rule: When the Add Swimlane popup opens, Below selected swimlane is selected by default.
wekan.pass_observation: The popup opens with Below selected swimlane selected.
wekan.fail_observation: The popup opens with Above selected swimlane selected or neither option selected.
wekan.probe_question: Which placement option is initially selected when the Add Swimlane popup opens?

wekan.target_rule: Dropping multiple selected boards onto Home must display "Please select only one board" while leaving Home and the selection unchanged.
wekan.pass_observation: The message appears, Home remains unchanged, and all previously selected boards remain selected.
wekan.fail_observation: Home switches to the first selected board instead of rejecting the drop and preserving the selection.
wekan.probe_question: What happens when you drop multiple selected boards onto Home?

wekan.target_rule: Reordering a field in either display-order list changes its position on the corresponding card surface without changing its position on the other surface.
wekan.pass_observation: Moving a field earlier in Show on Minicard moves it earlier on the minicard while its full-card position stays unchanged.
wekan.fail_observation: Moving a field earlier in Show on Minicard leaves its minicard position unchanged or also changes its full-card position.
wekan.probe_question: What happens to the minicard and full-card field order when a field is moved in Show on Minicard?

wekan.target_rule: When either membership restriction is enabled, a non-admin inviter can add a user to a board only if that user shares an organization or team of an enabled kind with the inviter or an active board member.
wekan.pass_observation: Adding a user who shares neither enabled membership kind is blocked in the board interface.
wekan.fail_observation: Adding a user who shares neither enabled membership kind succeeds and the user appears as a board member.
wekan.probe_question: How does adding a board member behave for users with different organization and team memberships when membership restrictions are enabled?

wekan.target_rule: Synchronizing an upstream title or description change updates the corresponding card text only if it still matches the last synchronized source value, preserving locally edited text otherwise.
wekan.pass_observation: After synchronization, unchanged local text reflects the upstream change, while locally edited text remains intact.
wekan.fail_observation: After synchronization, locally edited text is overwritten or unchanged local text fails to reflect the upstream change.
wekan.probe_question: What happens to a card’s title or description during synchronization when its upstream text changes, with and without local edits?

zulip.target_rule: Setting GIF picker to Disabled in Compose settings removes the GIF picker from the compose box.
zulip.pass_observation: The compose box does not show the GIF picker after it is disabled.
zulip.fail_observation: The compose box still shows the GIF picker after it is disabled.
zulip.probe_question: What appears in the compose box after changing the GIF picker setting to Disabled?

zulip.target_rule: Users can configure whether automated notices are automatically marked as read.
zulip.pass_observation: A web setting lets the user enable or disable automatically marking automated notices as read.
zulip.fail_observation: The web interface provides no way to change whether automated notices are automatically marked as read.
zulip.probe_question: What control does the user have over the read status of automated notices?

zulip.target_rule: When a user pastes a URL matching a reverse-enabled linkifier into the compose box, it automatically becomes linked text corresponding to that linkifier.
zulip.pass_observation: The pasted URL appears as the corresponding linked text, such as #2468, linking to the original URL.
zulip.fail_observation: The matching pasted URL remains a raw URL instead of becoming the corresponding linked text.
zulip.probe_question: What appears in the compose box after pasting a URL matching a reverse-enabled linkifier?

zulip.target_rule: The user subscription typeahead must exclude users already subscribed to the target channel.
zulip.pass_observation: The typeahead suggests matching users who are not subscribed and omits matching users already subscribed to the channel.
zulip.fail_observation: The typeahead suggests a user who is already subscribed to the channel.
zulip.probe_question: Which users appear in the subscription typeahead when matching users have different subscription statuses?

zulip.target_rule: Any user can unsubscribe themselves from a channel they belong to.
zulip.pass_observation: A non-admin user unsubscribes from a channel and sees that they are no longer subscribed.
zulip.fail_observation: A non-admin user is prevented from unsubscribing from a channel they belong to.
zulip.probe_question: What happens when a non-admin user tries to unsubscribe themselves from a channel?

zulip.target_rule: Conversations in a private channel are visible to users who have been granted access to that channel.
zulip.pass_observation: A user granted access can see the channel's conversations.
zulip.fail_observation: A user granted access cannot see the channel's conversations.
zulip.probe_question: Who can see conversations in a private channel?
